selected_evidence.requirement: node1 identified as router with eth1 (lan-a/node2) and eth2 (lan-b/node3)
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline topology discovery and interface-to-LAN mapping confirmed via temporary IP assignment + successful ping from node2/node3 to node1's respective interfaces

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 configured to route/forward between lan-a and lan-b
selected_evidence.summary: VyOS firewall ipv4 forward filter committed and saved with rules permitting eth1<->eth2 forwarding plus established/related; verified live via show firewall

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other directly on any port
selected_evidence.summary: ICMP reachable both directions; arbitrary TCP port 8765 HTTP GET succeeded from node3 to node2 after opening host firewalld to peer subnet

NAT source/destination rules confirmed not configured on node1; conntrack entries show unmodified src=10.50.2.12/dst=10.50.1.11 pairs including a completed TCP TIME_WAIT/ASSURED flow with no translation

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline forward-filter counters and node2->node3 ping captured; systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged; subsequent polls timed out proving disconnection; boot_id changed from 5bcff8f9-... to e2ec5d5c-...; post-restart config (addresses, firewall rules) and cross-LAN ping verified recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ef457a88-... and ping captured; systemctl reboot closed the connection; poll timed out confirming disconnect; new boot_id 9c397077-... confirmed; post-restart eth1 address, static route, firewalld source, and ping to node3 all verified recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 192f6cab-... and ping captured; systemctl reboot closed the connection; poll timed out confirming disconnect; new boot_id b5682da1-... confirmed; post-restart eth1 address, static route, firewalld source, and ping to node2 all verified recovered

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-all-restarts final health check of routing path
selected_evidence.summary: After all three restarts, node1 conntrack shows fresh unmodified ICMP flows between node2 and node3 and firewall forward-filter rules active with nonzero packet counters
